guidance.bestFor: The bare pattern with nothing added: chevron toggles and text only rows over a CRM outline of leads and accounts

whenNotToUse.when: Deep outlines where a line at each level helps the eye follow the nesting

guidance.bestFor: Thin vertical guide lines at each indent step behind plain text rows, painted by one gradient on the root
agentNotes: The lines are a `repeating-linear-gradient` in the `Tree` className spaced by `indent`, so a new `indent` moves them with the rows

whenNotToUse.when: Rows that need a folder or file glyph beside each name

guidance.bestFor: Guide lines with a folder glyph that turns into an open folder on expand and a file glyph on every leaf

whenNotToUse.when: Plus and minus marks on folders in place of turning chevrons
A code project with a colored glyph for each kind of file

guidance.bestFor: Plus and minus marks on folders in place of chevrons, over guide lines and open or closed folder glyphs

whenNotToUse.when: Chevrons that turn as a branch opens, with the same folder glyphs and lines

name: c-tree-5
title: File explorer tree with type icons
label: File Explorer
description: File explorer tree with type icons

guidance.bestFor: A code project outline with a colored glyph per file type: amber folders, blue code files, purple stylesheets and yellow JSON
agentNotes: `getFileIcon` maps each `type` to a glyph and color; a type it does not list, such as `config`, falls back to a plain file glyph
Folder rows come from `isItemFolder` counting `children`, not from `type`, so an empty folder record renders as a leaf

whenNotToUse.when: Folder and file glyphs in one muted color, with guide lines between levels

guidance.bestFor: People rows with a photo, name and job title under their manager, nested at a wider 24px step
agentNotes: Each `avatar` is a remote Unsplash URL; `AvatarFallback` shows initials taken from `name` while one loads or if it fails

guidance.bestFor: Role access grouped by area with a checkbox on each action row, plus and minus toggles and 5 grants on load
agentNotes: Grants live in local `checked` state seeded with 5 ids; save them to your API from `togglePermission`
Only leaf rows render a `Checkbox`, so an area row cannot grant or clear its whole group

whenNotToUse.when: Area rows that tick or clear every action under them and show a mixed state
